query:
SELECT EXISTS(
            SELECT 1
            FROM cheers_session_bindings b
            JOIN cheers_sessions s ON s.session_id = b.session_id
            WHERE b.bot_id = $1 AND b.scope_type = $2 AND b.scope_id = $3
              AND b.role = 'primary'
              AND s.status NOT IN ('terminated', 'revoked', 'expired')
        ) AS "value!"
